name: web-harvester
description: web-harvester lets Claude Code explore and act on the live web through the user's own real, logged-in browser (Growser) — with their cookies and sessions and none of the headless or bot-wall limits: screenshots, reading and moving data between tabs, clicking and filling forms on the user's behalf, opening and closing tabs, and checking pages on a timer. The bundled all-permissions extension provides the capabilities; the web-discover skill is the reference so Claude knows which one to reach for.
